'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[M23 campaign (2022–present)|M23 campaign]], [[Democratic Republic of the Congo–Rwanda conflict (2022–present)|Democratic Republic of the Congo–Rwanda conflict]]
**[[2025 Uvira offensive]]
***[[March 23 Movement|M23]] captures [[Sange, Democratic Republic of the Congo|Sange]], [[South Kivu]], from the [[Armed Forces of the Democratic Republic of the Congo|Congolese government]] and [[Burundi National Defense Force|Burundian troops]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/12/9/drc-accuses-rwanda-of-peace-deal-violations-as-m23-advances-in-the-east (Al Jazeera)] [https://www.sosmediasburundi.org/en/2025/12/09/south-kivu-m23-seizes-sange-triggering-a-massive-influx-into-burundi-and-a-retreat-of-burundian-troops/ (SOS Media Burundi)]
***M23 enter Uvira, with at least 20,000 people fleeing across the [[Burundi]]–[[Democratic Republic of the Congo|DRC]] border and reach [[Bujumbura]]. [https://actualite.cd/index.php/2025/12/09/uvira-face-la-progression-de-lafcm23-plus-de-20-000-personnes-ont-deja-trouve-refuge (Actualité <small>in French</small>)] [https://www.trtworld.com/article/1bcc51afdcc2 (TRT World)]
*[[2025 Cambodia‒Thailand conflict]]
**The [[Royal Thai Air Force]] carries out several [[airstrike]]s against [[Cambodia]], killing nine civilians and wounding 20 more. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2025/12/9/thailand-cambodia-live?update=4161571 (Al Jazeera)]
**Three [[Royal Thai Army|Thai soldiers]] are killed and 29 more injured during clashes with [[Royal Cambodian Army|Cambodian soldiers]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2025/12/9/thailand-cambodia-live?update=4161571 (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|Sudanese civil war]]
**Dozens of people are killed in a [[Drone warfare|drone strike]] by the [[Sudanese Armed Forces]] on an oil field in [[Heglig]], [[West Kordofan]], [[Sudan]]. [https://apnews.com/article/sudan-drone-strike-rsf-heglig-oil-a1decee69d735b3e0f02bd881b20b0a1 (AP)]

'''Arts and culture'''
*[[2025 Turner Prize]]
**[[British people|British]] [[Autism|autistic]] artist [[Nnena Kalu]] wins the 2025 [[Turner Prize]] for her wrapped fabric sculptures, becoming the first artist with a [[learning disability]] to win the award. [https://thesun.my/news/world-news/autistic-artist-nnena-kalu-wins-turner-prize/ (AFP via ''The Sun Malaysia'')] [https://www.theguardian.com/artanddesign/2025/dec/09/nnena-kalu-first-artist-learning-disability-win-turner-prize (''The Guardian'')]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[2025 IndiGo disruption]]
**The [[Directorate General of Civil Aviation (India)|Directorate General of Civil Aviation]] of [[India]] orders [[IndiGo]], the country's largest airline, to reduce its flights by 5% following a scheduling crisis last week that caused thousands of cancellations. [https://www.dw.com/en/indigos-woes-indian-airline-ordered-to-cut-flights-by-5/a-75073906 (DW)]
*[[Pakistani economic crisis (2022–2024)|Pakistani economic crisis]]
**The [[International Monetary Fund]] (IMF) approves the release of US$1.2 billion to [[Pakistan]] to assist with recovery from an economic crisis. The country has already received $3.3 billion from the IMF since last year. [https://apnews.com/article/pakistan-imf-approves-key-installment-bailout-54d10f9462db9df33e2094cb21953cd5 (AP)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2025 Terra Drone Building fire]]
**Twenty-two people are killed, while 19 are rescued, in a fire at a seven-story building in [[Jakarta]], [[Indonesia]]. [https://apnews.com/article/office-building-jakarta-indonesia-deadly-fire-fa998b4135754fdcd58f1b1364a0776a (AP)]
*Twelve people are killed and four more are injured in a fire at a four-story building in [[Shantou]], [[Guangdong]], [[China]]. [https://www.arabnews.com/node/2625672/world (AFP via ''Arab News'')]
*Seven people are killed when a [[Russian Air Force]] [[Antonov An-22]] military transport aircraft crashes during a test flight following repairs in [[Ivanovo Oblast]], [[Russia]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/crew-killed-crash-russian-an-22-military-plane-2025-12-09/ (Reuters)]
*A [[Sudanese Air Force]] [[Ilyushin Il-76]] aircraft crashes while landing at an air base in [[Port Sudan]], [[Red Sea State]], Sudan, killing all crew members. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/12/10/military-transport-plane-crashes-in-war-torn-sudan-killing-crew-report (Al Jazeera)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[2025 Catalonia swine fever outbreak]]
**The [[Catalonia|Catalan]] [[Government of Catalonia|government]] in [[Spain]] announces a [[state of emergency]] due to the rapid spread of [[African swine fever virus]] in [[wild boar]]s in a {{cvt|12|km|mi|abbr=on}} region to avoid spreading to other [[Autonomous communities of Spain|regions of Spain]]. [https://www.20minutos.es/cataluna/catalunya-declara-emergencia-para-contener-paliar-los-efectos-brote-peste-porcina_6908177_0.html (''20minutos'' <small>in Spanish</small>)] 

'''International relations'''
*[[Belarus–Lithuania relations]], [[Violations of non-combatant airspace during the Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present)|Violations of non-combatant airspace during the Russo-Ukrainian war]]
**[[Lithuania]] declares a state of national emergency over security risks from [[Belarus]]ian [[weather balloon]]s violating Lithuanian [[airspace]]. [https://apnews.com/article/lithuania-national-emergency-balloons-belarus-a24d39880e34e17c57fd76f799c35b33 (AP)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[War in Darfur]]
**[[International Criminal Court investigation in Darfur]]
***The [[International Criminal Court]] sentences [[Janjaweed]] militia leader [[Ali Kushayb]] to 20 years in prison for [[war crimes]] and [[crimes against humanity]] [[Darfur genocide (2003–2005)|committed during the war in Darfur]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/icc-sentences-darfur-janjaweed-militia-leader-20-years-2025-12-09/ (Reuters)]
*[[Catholic Church sexual abuse cases]]
**[[Catholic cardinal|Cardinal]] [[Timothy Dolan]] of the [[Roman Catholic]] [[Archdiocese of New York]] in the [[United States]] announces the archdiocese will set up a $300 million fund to compensate victims of [[sexual abuse]] who have sued the church. [https://apnews.com/article/new-york-archdiocese-abuse-fund-church-f26c80229d946760eca8e4a56633fddf (AP)]
*[[Malaysia Airlines Flight 370]]
**A [[Judicial system of China|court]] in [[Beijing]], [[China]], orders [[Malaysia Airlines]] (MH) to pay {{Renminbi|link=yes}}2.9 million (US$410,000) each to families of eight missing passengers of MH370, which disappeared after departing from [[Kuala Lumpur]] to Beijing in 2014. [https://apnews.com/article/mh370-china-lawsuit-malaysia-airline-22145b6ac7efa5c21f04fa01308883a8 (AP)]
*[[Operation Synytsia]]
**A [[Judiciary of Spain|court]] in [[Villajoyosa]], [[Spain]], provisionally closes its investigation into the [[Suspicious Russia-related deaths since 2022|killing]] of [[Russia]]n [[Defection|defector]] Maxim Kuzminov in the town after authorities cannot identify any perpetrators. [https://www.reuters.com/world/spanish-court-closes-probe-into-russian-defectors-murder-lack-suspects-2025-12-09/ (Reuters)]
*[[School violence in the United States]]
**One person is killed and another is critically injured in a [[School shooting|shooting]] at [[Kentucky State University]] in [[Frankfort, Kentucky|Frankfort]], [[Kentucky]], United States. A suspect is taken into custody. [https://bnonews.com/index.php/2025/12/shooting-reported-at-kentucky-state-university-multiple-injured (BNO News)]
*[[Australia]]'s [[Online Safety Amendment]] takes effect, age-restricting [[social media]] sites such as [[Facebook]], [[Twitter]] ([[X (social network)|X]]), [[TikTok]], and [[YouTube]], as well as accounts on the said sites registered to users under the age of 16. [https://www.cnn.com/2025/12/09/australia/australia-social-media-ban-starts-intl-hnk (CNN)]
*The [[Nepal]]ese [[Commission for the Investigation of Abuse of Authority]] charges 55 people, including former ministers and officials, and a [[China|Chinese]] engineering company with [[fraud]] related to inflating expenses in the construction of [[Pokhara International Airport]]. [https://apnews.com/article/nepal-china-corruption-airport-c112cb659a00efd348ea270f97f1e861 (AP)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2025 Czech parliamentary election]]
**[[Andrej Babiš]] of the [[Opposition (politics)|opposition]] [[ANO 2011|ANO]] party is appointed as [[Prime Minister of the Czech Republic|Prime Minister]] of the [[Czech Republic]] for his second non-consecutive term. [https://www.reuters.com/world/czech-president-appoints-andrej-babis-new-prime-minister-2025-12-09/ (Reuters)]
*[[2025 Guinea-Bissau coup d'état]]
**[[Guinea-Bissau]]'s [[High Military Command for the Restoration of National Security and Public Order|military junta]] adopts a one-year [[Provisional constitution|transitional charter]] that suspends the [[Constitution of Guinea-Bissau|constitution]], bars the interim leaders from contesting forthcoming [[Elections in Guinea-Bissau|elections]], and assigns the junta authority over political and institutional reforms until new elections are held at the end of the transition. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/guinea-bissaus-transitional-military-adopts-charter-barring-leaders-elections-2025-12-10/ (Reuters)]
*[[2025 Honduran general election]]
**[[Honduras|Honduran]] [[President of Honduras|president]] [[Xiomara Castro]] denounces the [[Electoral fraud|manipulation]] of the election results, which are still being counted, and accuses [[President of the United States|U.S. president]] [[Donald Trump]] of [[Foreign electoral intervention|interference]]. [https://www.france24.com/en/americas/20251210-honduran-vote-us-interference (AFP via France 24)]
*The [[Slovakia|Slovak]] [[National Council of Slovakia|parliament]] votes to abolish the country's [[whistleblower protection]] office and replace it with a new body. [https://www.reuters.com/world/slovakia-governments-actions-rule-law-ngos-media-2025-12-09/ (Reuters)]

'''Science and technology'''
*[[Chinese space program]]
**[[China National Space Administration|Chinese astronauts]] install [[Whipple shield|debris-shielding]] on the [[Tiangong space station]] following damage to the docked [[Shenzhou 20]] [[reentry capsule]] from [[Space debris|orbital debris]], and the crew conducts a [[spacewalk]] to prepare the compromised spacecraft for an [[Uncrewed spacecraft|uncrewed]] return. [https://www.reuters.com/science/chinese-astronauts-install-debris-protection-aboard-space-station-2025-12-09/ (Reuters)]

'''Sports'''
*[[2025 SEA Games]]
**The 2025 [[SEA Games]] [[2025 SEA Games opening ceremony|opens]] at the [[Rajamangala Stadium]] in [[Bangkok]], [[Thailand]], with heightened security for [[Cambodia at the 2025 SEA Games|Cambodian athletes]] and staff due to the [[2025 Cambodia‒Thailand conflict|ongoing Cambodia–Thailand conflict]]. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20251209-sea-games-to-open-in-thailand-with-tightened-security (AFP via France 24)]
